text: The chef who opened Saltmarsh & Rye was Benedikt Auer, according to the restaurant’s founding filing and a licensing notice filed with the Verdan City commerce office on Tuesday. The documents list Auer, 41, as both proprietor and executive chef of the coastal dining room, which opened this week in the South Quay district. In a brief statement attached to the filing, Auer said the menu will center on rye breads, cured fish and salt-preserved vegetables sourced from regional farms and fisheries. The lease was signed in February for the former Merrow Bank storefront, and the opening drew roughly 180 guests over two nights, the filing shows.
